禁评.definition:
The Chinese abbreviative word for banning comments（禁止评论），is a common means of restricting public opinion on Chinese websites.It is especially applied on websites where the theme involvs so called sensitive political information.Sometimes，other [interactive] functions are concurrently shut down to let all people shut down.

It deserves to mention that the pronunciation of this abbreviative phrase is the same as the first name of CCP's general secretary，Xijinping.Since Xi has come to power and [communication] censorship has [intensified]，the word is soon put forward and used among those who are dissatisfied with the control of expression.Before long，it correspondingly became a blocked word.
禁评.example:
—视频下方:当前评论区已被关闭
—video below:[Comment section] has been closed.
—呵呵，维尼熊又要禁评了
—Hoho，Wennie [The Pooh] bans our [communication] again.
